'''Tarinn''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] as a Head Jailer at the [[Imperial Holding Facility]] in [[Camp Conquest]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. In [[3642 BBY]], Tarinn confronted the [[The Barsen'thor|Barsen'thor]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] [[Battle of Balmorra (Galactic Wars)|mission]] to liberate the Balmorran prisoners from the facility. The Barsen'thor killed Tarinn and retrieved his security card from him, using it to open the cells.
